source.title: PyMeeus 0.5.12 Coordinates.ecliptic_horizon published example
source.scope: Numeric example only; no library code or dependency is included.

conventions: Source sidereal input is 5 hours, converted to 75 degrees. Source gives two antipodal horizon intersections, not an identified Ascendant or Midheaven. No date, geographic longitude, atmosphere or sidereal-time model is specified. Tolerance is twice the 0.05 arcsecond half-step of the printed 0.1 arcsecond rounding; fixed before running the comparison.
